algorithm: LightGBM hurdle ensemble: 3 seeds x (binary classifier for P(any DCFC) x Tweedie-1.5 regressor for port count on positive tracts); predictions are the seed-mean of P x clip(count, 0, None)
target: DC fast-charge ports per census tract
artifact: m4_hurdle.joblib (joblib, compress=3): dict with models [(clf, reg) x 3 seeds], features, enc_table, enc_globals, predict note

data_vintages.stations: NLR AFDC pull, Oct 2026 (83,546 stations; 79,187 DCFC ports)
data_vintages.registrations: CA/WA/NY/MD/PA by ZIP + VA by county (harmonized: VA excluded from features, NY flagged BEV-only)
data_vintages.traffic: FHWA HPMS 2024 arterial AADT — county aggregates plus tract-level extraction (74.6% of tracts contain an arterial section)
data_vintages.land_use: OpenStreetMap via Geofabrik, all five US regions (80,794 tracts covered), as in-tract counts plus 1/3/5 km buffer and density features
data_vintages.corridors: BTS NTAD Alternative Fuel Corridors — distance to nearest EV-designated corridor (2,180 segments, 83,366 miles) plus 1-mile/5-mile flags

lineage: M4 is draft8 of the M3 line: M3 (R2 0.335) + nationwide POI coverage + POI buffer/density features + Tweedie sizing objective + tract-level AADT + state target encoding + EV-corridor proximity. Tested and NOT shipped: LODES 2019-2023 growth trends (MAE-positive, R2-negative) and Microsoft building footprints, 141.8M buildings aggregated per tract (best MAE of any variant at 0.9827 single-seed but R2 a tie; substitution for POI features clearly worse, 0.310).
